review: Independent reviews passed for shared producers, borrowed Console access, repair reduction/visibility/continuation, client clock generation ordering, Workshop documentation and browser fixture. Final typed comparator and integration fixture corrections also passed read-only review.
corrected_validation_failures: Migrated legacy codec, native pane and producer-ordering test fixtures to explicit absent/empty optional metadata; replaced drained Vec.into_iter().count() with len(). No assertions weakened.

The historical composite Console payload fixture now expects explicit unknown observation time and an empty report list. Its complete strict equality assertion remains in place; full JavaScript rerun passes.
Same-tick damage reports remain admissible after an operational recovery diagnosis; only strictly older samples are rejected.
Client publication/clock generation ordering prevents late old packets from ageing or replacing new continuation records.
Report canonical ordering uses typed subject/provenance comparison, keeping serde_json within codec.

Full peer-transfer integration caught RON decoding failure for the internally tagged observation System subject. A field-local scalar encoding preserves global SystemId formats and JSON; named-System RON blackboard and repair-state regressions and the full native suite pass.
PASM AI attribution uses supported [ai] rationale markers; an unsupported entity-level origin field was corrected and the affected spec gates pass.

The broader Workshop Preview case initially lacked its separate dist/preview viewer build. Built the current viewer in the same local debug profile as the main WASM, installed it, and reran both Workshop cases without changing runtime or assertions.

visual_inspection.result: Desktop browser fixture inspected: source, original sample, receipt, logical age, unknown precision and repair contributors readable; concealed deficit absent.
